purpose: Generic application status workflow with ordering, terminality and whether citizen action is required.
collection_mode: Knowledge synthesis from documented public sources (WebFetch to government domains blocked by environment egress policy)
source_tier: Tier 3 (observed common workflow across scheme portals)
methodology: Eight statuses covering the workflow named in the specification, plus QUERY_RAISED which the specification omitted but which is the single most common cause of silent application failure when an applicant does not respond in time. citizen_action_required is the operationally important column: it distinguishes waiting from being blocked.
known_limitations: This is a generic reference workflow, not any one portal's state machine. Individual portals use different status labels and some add scheme-specific states. Consumers should map portal-specific statuses onto these codes rather than expecting an exact match.
